author: Salem Techsperts
description: iBuyProblems was the nickname I gave iBuyPower due to issues from their 2021-2022 PC's, which were the result of low quality components and sloppy QC. After seeing their progress in 2024 where more PC's were coming in for upgrades vs repair, I decided to accept iBUYPOWER's offer to visit their facility to see exactly what changes they made.
title: Is iBUYPOWER Still iBuyProblems? #pc #computer #tech #technology #shorts
